event_properties.content: Which platform has my worst ratings?

**Swiggy** has your lowest average at 3.6 ★. The primary drivers are delivery time complaints and packaging issues — both of which are delivery-specific problems. Your restaurant ratings (Google, Dineout) are significantly higher at 4.0+.
Which platform has my worst ratings?

**Swiggy** has your lowest average at 3.6 ★. The primary drivers are delivery time complaints and packaging issues — both of which are delivery-specific problems. Your restaurant ratings (Google, Dineout) are significantly higher at 4.0+.
Can you summarise this week's feedback?

This week: **247 total reviews** across all platforms. 68% positive, 18% neutral, 14% negative. Highlights: customers love the new dessert menu. Pain points: parking, wait times on Friday evenings. Net Promoter Score estimate: **+34** (up from +29 last week).
How many 1-star reviews did I get this week?

You received **8 one-star reviews** this week — 5 on Zomato, 2 on Swiggy, and 1 on Google. I've flagged the top 3 most detailed ones for your review. Would you like me to draft response templates for them?
What time of day do most complaints come in?
Most complaints are submitted between **8pm–10pm**, which aligns with dinner rush hours. Delivery complaints peak at **9pm**. Consider adding an extra delivery coordinator during this window.
